scenario: `/` (true division, Float) and `//` (floor division, Int) are distinct (LEXP.7.4 vs LEXP.7.5): 7 / 2 == 3.5 while 7 // 2 == 3. The guard requires BOTH to hold, so it fires only if the two operators are not conflated. Companion to LEXP.7.4.div, guarding against a regression that makes `/` truncate like `//`.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    a: Int key
    b: Int mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.a / t.b) == 3.5 and (t.a // t.b) == 3
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
